g.text: Core Workspace Topology & Extracted Subsystems (ADR-0003 / ADR-0015 / ADR-0016)

text.tspan: Rules: Strict DAG, no cycles. Lower layers never depend on higher. Renderer reads snapshot only.
Core retains Terminal Truth & Capability gate. bitty-core & bitty-panels retired (bitty#1603, bitty#1604).
bitty-agent, bitty-ipc, bitty-observability, bitty-network extracted to independent repositories.
